title: Clandestine Off-Grid Meeting with Kaelen Vance (Foul Play / Coercion)
summary: Maya Lin was solicited by art broker Kaelen Vance for an off-grid photo shoot, acquired a burner phone, deleted posts regarding their dinner meeting, and traveled to Whispering Pines Overlook where her handset ceased transmission.

supporting_evidence.detail: Account @kaelen_v reached out on Day 31 offering high payment for an off-grid architectural shoot.
Alias @m.shadow_7 registered on Day 36 specifically following @kaelen_v.
Three posts mentioning 'Meeting with K at Pacific Horizon Diner' deleted from @mayalin_art (recovered via web archive cache).
Prepaid handset (+1-555-0199) exchanged 5 calls exclusively with Kaelen Vance (+1-555-0188).
Final post from @m.shadow_7 and cell tower sector TOWER-PAC-09 both pin Whispering Pines Overlook at 21:45 UTC on March 14.

contradicting_evidence.item: Absence of Overt Physical Struggle in Digital Logs
contradicting_evidence.detail: Public microblog entries do not record an explicit distress SOS message before terminal silence.

recommended_actions: Issue search warrant for cell records and subscriber identity of Kaelen Vance (+1-555-0188).
Deploy ground search and rescue units to Whispering Pines Overlook (37.8924, -122.5719).
Subpoena surveillance footage from Pacific Horizon Diner for March 14, 17:00-18:30 UTC.

title: Abduction / Vengeance by Ex-Partner Lucas Reed (Disproven Red Herring)
summary: Suspicion arose due to hostile social media comments from ex-partner Lucas Reed, but corroborating telecommunications and flight travel verify an ironclad alibi.

supporting_evidence.detail: Lucas posted aggressive messages demanding the return of audio equipment on Day 20.

contradicting_evidence.detail: Lucas checked in at SFO Airport Marriott Gateway at 18:50 UTC on March 14.
Handset (+1-555-0155) pinged SFO Airport Tower Sector TOWER-SFO-12 at 19:10 UTC, followed by boarding of flight SEA-441 to Seattle.

recommended_actions: De-escalate investigative priority on Lucas Reed; maintain alibi flight manifest in evidentiary case file.

title: Voluntary Relocation to Mexico (Fabricated Impersonation Red Herring)
summary: Claims of Maya fleeing to Cabo San Lucas published by @mayalin_travels were proven fraudulent through EXIF digital forensics and perceptual hash matching.

supporting_evidence.detail: Account @mayalin_travels published beach photos with hashtags #escape #mexico on Day 44.

contradicting_evidence.detail: Forensic EXIF extraction from photo PH-010 shows capture date of 2024-06-15, two years prior to current case.
Camera signature is Apple iPhone 8; target Maya Lin utilizes Sony Alpha a7 IV and Google Pixel 7.
pHash identifies the photograph as a reposted stock image, indicating an opportunistic bot or troll account.

recommended_actions: Flag @mayalin_travels as fraudulent disinformation; issue take-down notice to prevent public distraction.
